title: Murree & Galiyat Weekend
summary: A long weekend from Lahore in the pine hills of the Galiyat: forest walks at Nathia Gali and Ayubia, and cool evenings above the clouds.

image.alt: Pine-covered ridges of the Galiyat at dusk, with monsoon cloud filling the valleys below

overview.headline: A cool long weekend in the pine hills above Islamabad
paragraphs: Three easy days for when Lahore is too hot. We stay two nights at Nathia Gali, high in the Galiyat, with gentle forest walks and evenings cool enough for a jacket.
There is time for the Mushkpuri trail and the Pipeline Track at Ayubia, and time to do nothing at all on a veranda above the clouds.
suitedTo: Families with young children and grandparents
Couples and friends with only a long weekend
First-timers who want a taste of the hills before a longer trip
notSuitedTo: Anyone hoping for snow peaks and glaciers; these are forested hills
Travellers who want quiet roads on Eid and public holidays

itinerary.title: Lahore → Nathia Gali
itinerary.text: Up the motorway to Islamabad, then into the hills past Murree to Nathia Gali, in time for tea.

itinerary.title: Mushkpuri and the Pipeline Track
itinerary.text: A gentle morning walk to Mushkpuri Top, then the level Pipeline Track from Ayubia in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Nathia Gali → Lahore
itinerary.text: A slow morning, then back down through Murree and home by evening.

faqs.question: How cold does it get?
faqs.answer: Days are mild in summer, but evenings at Nathia Gali can drop to 12 °C. Bring a light jacket, and a warmer one in May and October.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for grandparents?
faqs.answer: Yes. The walks are optional and gentle, the hotel is a short drive from everything, and there are no long road days.
